TypeSignature.Value: .class public auto ansi beforefieldinit AgentSessionFiles extends System.Object

Docs.summary: Session-scoped file operations for hosted agent sandboxes. These endpoints enable uploading, downloading, listing, and deleting files within a live ADC sandbox session. All file content is streamed end-to-end (no buffering in Agents service memory). Sessions are scoped to agent endpoints (not individual versions), allowing the endpoint to evolve the backing agent version independently of the session lifecycle.
